steps.name: Step 1 — Open a pipeline with a custom state variable ('custom_output')
Step 2 — Locate the trash icon (delete) button next to 'custom_output'
Step 3 — Click trash icon; verify the variable is removed from the panel
Step 4 — Verify default 'input'/'messages' still render NO delete control
Step 5 — Save the pipeline; verify no console errors and a 201 Created response
